report_title: June 2026 Quarterly Activities Report (FY26 results, web-derived)
notes: AISC in AUD converted to USD at assumed FY26 average AUD:USD 0.65 (approximate). MD Luke Tonkin. Group AISC A$2,924/oz. FY26 sales 334,901 oz @ A$5,557/oz. Cash and bullion A$841.6M, no debt. Maiden dividend + buybacks A$74.3M. MERGER PENDING: agreed scheme with Genesis Minerals Ltd (GMD) announced 14 Jul 2026 ('Genesis & Vault agree to merge, creating a new gold major'), implementation scheduled Q2 FY27 - Vault to be absorbed into Genesis; treat successor as GMD. FY27 guidance 355,000-375,000 oz @ A$3,150-3,350/oz AISC. 2026 R&R statement (saved PDF) effective 30 Jun 2026: Ore Reserves 143.6 Mt @ 0.8 g/t = 3.9 Moz (+9% YoY post depletion).

mines.processing: KoTH processing plant (5.3 Mtpa; Stage 1 crusher commissioned Mar 2026; Stage 2 upgrade to 7.5-8.0 Mtpa commissioning Sep 2026, ahead of schedule)
mines.mine_notes: WA. Largest contributor (53% of production). FY26 AISC A$2,723/oz converted at 0.65. Ore Reserves 128.5 Mt @ 0.7 g/t = 2.74 Moz (+7% post depletion). FY27 guidance 198,000-208,000 oz.

mines.processing: Processing plant (Daisy underground primary feed; Santa open pit)
mines.mine_notes: WA. FY26 AISC A$3,025/oz converted at 0.65. Daisy underground supports production through FY27. Ore Reserves 11.1 Mt @ 1.7 g/t = 602 koz. FY27 guidance 83,000-89,000 oz. Tower Hill open pit and Bruno Lewis projects in development within region.
WA. FY26 AISC A$3,282/oz converted at 0.65. Owner-operator mining assumed 18 Nov 2025. Ore Reserves 1.7 Mt @ 3.1 g/t = 170 koz (incl. Rothsay). FY27 guidance 74,000-78,000 oz.

Ontario, Canada. Underground development recommenced 1 Jul 2026 (Closure Plan Amendment certified Jun 2026); planned production restart Q1 FY28. Ore Reserves 2.4 Mt @ 5.1 g/t = 398 koz (Sugar South maiden reserve). No FY26 production.

reserves_resources.notes: Daisy Complex 82 koz @ 6.2 g/t; Mount Belches 400 koz; stockpiles 121 koz
